## What changed and why?

Describe the problem or improvement. Link a related issue if there is one.

## How was it checked?

List the relevant checks and their results. For documentation-only changes, say so. Include a before/after image for a visual change when useful.

## Relevant details

- [ ] The change is focused and described clearly.
- [ ] New interface text is covered in Polish and English, if applicable.
- [ ] Map/data/artwork sources and license notices are included, if applicable.
- [ ] Test screenshots and caches are isolated; personal data and generated binaries are excluded.

Anything the reviewer should pay particular attention to?
